## Circular to All Licensed Corporations

## Reminder of Importance of Prudent Risk Management 1

In view of recent market volatility, the SFC reminds all licensed corporations the importance of  implementing  effective  risk  management  policies  and  appropriate  risk  management controls.

Senior management of licensed corporations are responsible for properly managing the risks of their firms, including maintenance of appropriate risk management policies and procedures and evaluation of risk exposures and effectiveness of the related controls. They should aim to ensure that the risks associated with the licensed corporation's business and operations are identified and managed in a timely manner. In particular, we would like to draw attention to the following areas:

- Prudent  trading  and  position  (both  intraday  and  overnight)  limits  for  clients  and  own accounts are established and their compliance is closely monitored and strictly enforced;
- Credits granted to clients are commensurate with the financial status of the clients and quality of collateral;
- Prudent margin requirements are set and outstanding margin calls are made and collected on a timely basis;
- Risk exposures are contained to an appropriate level to avoid concentration of risks; and
- Vigilant monitoring of changes in market conditions is carried out and their impacts on the firm's risk management, operations and financial resources are timely addressed.

Should  you  have  any  queries  regarding  the  contents  of  this  circular,  pleases  contact  Ms Denise Chan at 2842-7751.
